# For The Street Foundation

> For The Street Foundation (FTS) is a youth-led nonprofit organisation in Ghana, established in 2024 by a group of young people who share a passion for humanity and community development. It works to improve the lives of underprivileged and street-connected people through donation programs, volunteerism and community support. Tagline: "Hope that meets people where they are."

Last updated: 2026-11-27

## Name and identity

- Official name: For The Street Foundation (note: "Street" is singular, with no "s"). Short form: FTS.
- Type: youth-led, non-profit charitable organisation.
- Country: Ghana.
- Website: https://for-the-street-foundation.vercel.app/
- Founded: 2024.
- Branches: Takoradi and Accra.

## Origin and belief

The foundation was born in the founder's final year at Adisadel College, out of a personal desire to make a meaningful difference in society and to extend a helping hand to people who are often neglected or overlooked.

FTS began with a simple but powerful belief: everyone deserves an opportunity to live a better life, regardless of their social or economic background. What started as a vision to support vulnerable individuals has grown into a movement driven by compassion, volunteerism and the desire to create lasting social impact.

## Who the foundation serves

Underprivileged and street-connected individuals in Ghana, and people who are often overlooked by society.

## What the foundation does

- Organises donation programs (outreach activities) where volunteers give directly to people in need.
- Brings young people together to volunteer and give back.
- Invites individuals and organisations to give, volunteer or partner with the foundation.

## Donation programs so far

Each program is shown on the website as its own photo story. Photos from different programs are never mixed.

- Where It All Began: the foundation's first ever donation, held in Takoradi.
- Two Teams, One Mission: held in Accra. It was the third donation in Accra and the first time the Accra and Takoradi teams gave together as one.
- Donation Program 3: held in Accra. Volunteers in For The Street Foundation shirts handed over gifts in person on the streets, stopping to talk with each person they met.

Exact dates for these programs have not been published yet.

## Leadership

Takoradi branch:
- Samuel Kojo Afoah Jnr, President
- Othnevia Serwaa Asomaning, Vice President

Accra branch:
- Kelvin Sedem Fugar, President
- Oswald Agyekum Gyamfi, Vice President

## What is on the website

The site is a single page with these sections:

- Home: the foundation's mission, "Offering hope to people who need it most."
- About ("Our story"): who the foundation is and how it began.
- Programs: photo stories of each donation program.
- Leadership: the four branch leaders listed above.
- Get Involved: ways to donate and a contact card.

## How to help

People can donate, volunteer or partner with the foundation through the Get Involved section of the website.
